description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class 'BrandedActivity' that manages branding aspects such as theme colors and menu icon styling, integrating with Nextcloud Notes app branding utilities.

classes.name: BrandedActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity class that applies branding styles and behaviors, such as color theming and menu icon styling, for activities in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, applying edge-to-edge padding via an extension function.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Resolves theme attributes to set the accent color and observes branding data to apply branding styles.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Iterates over menu items to style toolbar icons according to branding utilities.
